title.narrative: OS1.4 % of citizens who are staffed with the overall quality of services offered by targeted local authorities ( disaggregated by sex, age, disability status

description.narrative: Indicator requires a satisfaction survey be conducted. it is a percentage of the citizens in formed groups reporting that they are satisfied with the quality of service provision

comment.narrative: During the period under review Impact Indicator 1 was not due to be measured. However while the indicator was not measured in a statistically representative manner this year data collection was done using scorecards to assess levels of satisfaction with the overall quality of services by the targeted local authorities.
